review.scope: Original Pocket foundation geometry, ready for Bean identity and standard/custom build development. This does not approve or complete all 20 dependent SKUs.
review.sourceProvenance: Original Blender vertex/face construction from the user-provided Pocket art direction; no downloaded or externally generated geometry.

findings.silhouette: Compact upright hatch with a short bonnet, broad squared face, ivory roof cap, substantial bumpers, and oversized dish wheels; visibly distinct from the M03 track coupe.
findings.printedGraphics: 01, stripes, lamp graphics, windows and POCKET label are UV artwork. They disappear in the actual clay render.
findings.geometry: 6672 evaluated triangles, closed positive-volume meshes, no degenerate faces, no tire/body intersections, common zero ground plane.
findings.unity: 18 mesh renderers, 6672 imported triangles, correct 89.25 mm length, UV0 artwork present on both sides and front/rear, no missing materials or UVs.
repairsVerified: FBX root axis and scale preservation

limitations: 6672 triangles is slightly above the 6000 starting guideline; crowd LOD and batching remain to be implemented.
Unity uses a realtime studio with directional shadows, so lighting is not identical to Cycles.
Bean identity, custom builds, additional liveries, packaging and final SKU-prefab assembly remain unfinished.
